title: Mouse without borders is not working-not connecting
summary: Mouse Without Borders 0.99.1 fails to connect two PCs after entering the key and computer name, with red/yellow device indicators; no diagnostics or network conditions are supplied.
next_action: Request paired current-version connection reports and a minimal sanitized network description; do not request the security key.

judgment.rationale: The symptom spans name resolution, connection transport and authentication paths. Related issues describe distinguishable mapping, interface and identity failures, none established here. Confirm behavior on current stable on both PCs and obtain paired diagnostics/topology before proposing a fix or declaring a duplicate.
evidence: The report supplies version 0.99.1 and the Connect sequence but no ZIP, per-PC versions or network conditions.
The automated comment recommends current stable and lists 40764, 39759 and 43841 as possible duplicates, not confirmed matches.
40764 is closed as duplicate of 43841; 43841 concerns subnet/mapping behavior, while 39759 concerns machine identity/case.
judgment.recommended_action: Request paired current-version connection reports and a minimal sanitized network description; do not request the security key.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report does not yet identify an applicable PowerToys code correction. No fix is proposed from an unlocalized symptom; this is not a conclusion that the behavior is expected or externally owned.

comment.body:
Thanks for describing the Connect attempt and the red/yellow indicators on 0.99.1. Those indicators do not yet distinguish name resolution, network connection and key/authentication failures; the related subnet/mapping reports have prerequisites that are not confirmed here.

Please provide:
1. The PowerToys version on each PC. If possible, update both to the latest stable release, retry Connect and say whether the failure remains; if updating is not possible, say so.
2. Whether the PCs are on the same local network/subnet, and whether either uses a VPN, multiple active network adapters or manual IP mappings. A short description is enough; do not post the security key, real computer names or network addresses.
3. Immediately after the same failed connection attempt, add a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated diagnostic ZIP from each PC, marked PC A and PC B, plus the approximate attempt time. Review the reports for sensitive information before sharing.

This lets us compare both ends of the failed connection and decide whether an existing network/mapping issue applies rather than guessing a fix.
